Cocktail bar in LoDo. Happy hour runs from four to six on weekdays, with half-price classics and a short bar menu. Scroll to see the content pass under the bar.

The bar stays pinned at the top of the scrolling area while the page moves under it.

It is opaque when the person asks for less transparency.
